title: Modernize anchored neutral steps and micro shadow curves
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: update core token ramps to reduce visual noise at dense sizes and provide deterministic elevation behavior for compact components. Scope includes: a 12-step anchored neutral color ramp (neutral-00..neutral-11) optimized for UI text, borders and surfaces; a refined typography scale mapping for compact/regular density; two responsive radius tokens (radius-compact, radius-cozy) with proportional deltas; and a micro-shadow curve system (shadow-micro-1 / shadow-micro-2) for small controls and table rows. Deliverables: token spec, Figma token file, mapping/migration doc for components, engineering PRs to wire tokens, regression checklist and visual diffs. Success metrics: reduce perceived contrast clashes in dense tables (qualitative), maintain WCAG text contrast for neutral-11/neutral-01 pairs, and no regressions on button visual states in canary tests.
decision_log: Adopt 12-step anchored neutral ramp vs. existing 8-step to smooth interpolation when applying alpha overlays
Use hue-locked neutral ramp with perceptual lightness spacing (Cam16/OKLCH sampling) for consistent layering
Introduce two micro-shadow layers: micro-ambient (soft 6% blur) and micro-key (subtle 2% offset) to preserve motion performance on low-end GPUs
Radius tokens will be proportional (radius-compact = base * 0.66, radius-cozy = base * 1.0) to reduce hard edges in dense lists
Keep base typography scale but add a -compact variant for 11/12px use in dense tables and chip labels
